paragraphs: Before takeoff, conduct the safety demonstration and cabin check. During cruise, serve meals and water and monitor the cabin. Stabilize and respond during turbulence. Collect service items and guide passengers before descent. After landing, clear the cabin, complete the handoff, and prepare for the next flight.

In one sentence, Flight Attendants care for people in the air. They conduct demonstrations, serve meals, monitor the cabin, respond to incidents, guide arrivals, and clear the cabin. The role is the flight's passenger-facing front line.
